fusions.name: Running Flame
fusions.desc: Throws a burning mesh that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. The flame runs along the cords: your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Held in the Blaze
fusions.desc: Drops a burning mesh on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 fire damage that ignores resistance, leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Burning Weir
fusions.desc: Stretches a burning mesh 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smouldering Bolas
fusions.desc: Conjures a weighted cord that smoulders in your hand: your weapon damage rises by 12%, your strikes land 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.
